upgrades.name: First Upgrade
upgrades.description: Adds a kitchen with a cooking stove and mini-fridge, plus a bedroom with a double bed.

upgrades.name: Second Upgrade
upgrades.description: Expands the house with more rooms and adds a children's room. Unlocks the renovation menu.

upgrades.name: Cellar
upgrades.description: Adds a cellar beneath the farmhouse for aging artisan goods in casks.

renovations.name: Open Bedroom
renovations.description: Removes the wall between the master bedroom and the main room, opening up the space.

renovations.name: Southern Room
renovations.description: Adds a large room to the south of the farmhouse.

renovations.name: Corner Room
renovations.description: Adds a room in the upper-right corner of the farmhouse.

renovations.name: Extended Corner Room
renovations.description: Extends the corner room further. Requires the Corner Room to be built first.

renovations.name: Dining Room
renovations.description: Adds a dining room to the left side of the farmhouse.

renovations.name: Cubby
renovations.description: Adds a small cubby nook near the children's room.

renovations.name: Attic
renovations.description: Adds an attic room above the upper floor of the farmhouse.

renovations.name: Remove Crib
renovations.description: Removes the crib from the children's room. The crib can be rebuilt at no cost.
renovations.note: Free. Requires a crib to already be present. Toggle via the renovation menu.
